# 🎮 VPX Achievement Watcher — Release Notes v3.2

## 👥 Multiplayer & live tracking (VPX 10.8.1+)
- Up to 4 players are tracked via superhac's score-server plugin
- Every game counts on its own – nothing from the previous game is added up
- Overlay page 1 opens automatically when a game ends, not again when the table is closed
- If the table is closed during a game (60 s or longer), that game is shown when closing; games shorter than 60 s are ignored
- 1 player: achievements unlock live during the game (from ball 2 on – unlocks from ball 1 follow then), counted per game
- 2–4 players: no achievements; page 1 shows one column per player: score, Best Ball, highlights and the table actions of that player, plus the winner
- Table actions are split per player from live NVRAM snapshots sent by the plugin
- Best Ball now uses the real points scored on each ball (single player and multiplayer)
- ROMs whose game status the plugin cannot read: a notice at table start ("Live tracking & multiplayer not available … Close the table to see your results."), then everything works like 10.8.0
- The Watcher installs and enables the plugins automatically (score-server + PinMAME plugin with superhac's GetController patch, built for VPX 10.8.1)
- If a VPX update replaces the PinMAME plugin with the same version, the multiplayer version is restored automatically; a new PinMAME version is reported in the Dashboard
- VPX older than 10.8.1 or no plugin build available: everything as before
- Detects every VPX executable (VPinballX, 64, GL, BGFX) and the new 10.8.1 settings location (%APPDATA%\VPinballX\10.8\VPinballX.ini)

## ⚔️ Score Duels
- Score Duels are hidden for now (tab, overlay page, duel notifications, duel hotkeys, duel sounds)
- Picture-in-Picture live stream removed completely
- Tournament mode hidden

## 🧹 Clean-up
- Mascots (Steely / Trophie) removed

## 🖼️ Overlay
- Page 1 redesigned: compact layout, everything that does not fit scrolls like page 2 (same text size, nothing cut off)
- Run Status card and the in-game status badge removed
- VPC Weekly Challenge page removed – the overlay now has 3 pages (Highlights, Achievement Progress, Cloud Leaderboard)
- Overlay page on/off settings no longer get mixed up after a restart
- Main overlay stays on the playfield screen on dual-monitor setups (no more split across two screens); your own placement is kept

## 🐛 Fixes
- Overlay page "Cloud Leaderboard" always showed "Failed to fetch cloud data"
- Tables in sub-folders of the Tables directory are now detected while playing ("Unable to find NVRAM" / "No active game")
- Tables with a ROM alias (Serum / PuP / MOD versions, e.g. afm_113Serum) are now tracked correctly (#880)
- Installer now reports the correct version
- Highlight "Multiball Frenzy" is now "Multiball" and counts each multiball once (several multiball audits were added up before)

## ☁️ Cloud, Anti-Cheat & Backup
- New cloud protection: every Watcher signs in automatically (no input needed) and your Player ID is linked to your PC – nobody else can upload for it
- **Recovery Key** (System → General, also in Backup to ZIP): moves your Player ID to another PC – keep it safe
- Existing players keep all their progress; the Player ID is linked automatically on the first start
- The cloud now checks every upload (valid values, matching leaderboard entry, upload rate) and player names are unique
- Leaderboards: top 25 per table and top 50 overall, plus your own place
- Overall leaderboard now also counts global achievements
- Rarity comes from shared counters (same result, a fraction of the traffic)
- Much less cloud traffic: no more background polling, no download of all players' data
- Save files changed outside the Watcher still load, but cloud uploads pause until you restore from the cloud or a backup; a damaged save file falls back to its last good copy
- Restore from ZIP now checks the backup signature
- Live achievements are uploaded at the end of the game, not during it
- New update banner and minimum-version check
- Backup is always active when Cloud Sync is on (ZIP backup/restore)
- Older Watcher versions can no longer upload – please update

## 🖥️ Main window
- Smaller and more compact (1100 × 720), 6 tabs: Dashboard, Player, Tables, Stats, Appearance, System
- New Dashboard layout
- Themes as clickable color tiles
- Sound moved into "Sound & Effects"
- System → General in two columns, Maintenance buttons in a grid
- Overlay positions: separate Place and Save buttons

## 🏅 Achievements (VPX 10.8.1)
- Every achievement stage reached in a game is unlocked right away
- Overlay progress bar is up to date when the overlay appears
